title: There plastic not glass.
text:
There plastic not glass.. These come with white salt, and black pepper corn in them.
I’m trying to get the bottom of the salt shakers little rubber stopper out to put in
Himalayan pink salt in, but can’t get it out. Also not sure the holes are big enough for a good pink salt!

This white salt taste biter to me, but I’m not use to white salt anymore.
The pepper grinder seems to work well, it gives a fine grind. A fine grind can give a hotter pepper.

My mistake I’m made is I thought these salt and pepper mill where going to be glass, as it should have
Said these are plastic in the beginning.

They look like a cheesy plastic to me.
Over price for plastic salt and pepper mill

product_metadata.title: Cole & Mason Macclesfield Pepper Mill and Salt Shaker Gift Set, 5.5"", Clear"
features: One Salt Shaker and One Pepper Shaker Set
Made from clear acrylic and stainless steel shaker cap
This mill shake is 5.5" inches tall
Easy refill, for pepper, unscrew the stainless steel mill head, pop off the top, and refill with whole peppercorns. For salt shaker, remove silicone bung at the base to refill with ground salt.
Hand wash with damp cloth, do not submerge in water
description: A sleek and stylish set of contemporary salt and pepper mills that have the mechanism at the top ensuring that kitchen worktops, cupboards, and dining tables stay clean and mess-free. Easy to use; simply pick up, turn upside down, and twist to start shaking. The clear acrylic body ensures you will always have visibility of how much salt or pepper is in your mills. The wide base makes refilling easy and mess-free.
